text:
Sabeel: Quick heads-up, SableBank wants to confirm networking option for POC — they need preserved source IPs for fraud logs and also strict firewalling. asking if PrivateLink can do this with our NLB path.
Raj: short answer: PrivateLink hides customer source behind our ENIs, so source IPs won't be preserved end-to-end. VPC Peering preserves source IP.
Sabeel: ok — they care about L7 logs that include client IP. if PrivateLink breaks that, they'd prefer peering. any security/regulatory blockers for peering?
Olivia: peering is fine from a compliance POV, but they must control ACLs and we need to agree egress ACLs. also consider routing overlap — we need non-overlapping CIDR.
Kevin: alternative: we can terminate at a customer-managed proxy (NLB -> customer infra) that preserves client IP if they front with a TCP proxy that uses proxy protocol. we have an option to enable `proxy_protocol_v2` on our NLB.
Raj: yes `proxy_protocol_v2` will pass the original IP in proxy header to their service. but that requires them to run proxy-aware endpoints.
Sabeel: can you confirm firewall ports and egress IPs we announce for Private deployments? customer asked for list for their allowlist/security questionnaire.
DeployBot: auto: provisioning note — PrivateLink endpoints use ENIs in customer subnets; outbound traffic to our control plane uses 3 IP ranges: 34.211.0.0/16, 54.204.0.0/16, 18.197.0.0/16 (example). confirm with RS.
Olivia: don't copy those ranges straight into the questionnaire — those are example ranges. for POC, give them the current published egress IPs from our handbook (see link) and note that Dedicated/Private may have different ranges per-region.
Sabeel: they also asked about TLS and SNI. they want TLS inspection at their perimeter and want to know if SNI will be preserved through PrivateLink/NLB.
Raj: SNI is part of TLS ClientHello and is visible unless there's TLS termination. If we terminate TLS at our edge (hosted), SNI won't reach their backend. If using Private deployment with customer-managed termination, SNI preserved.
Kevin: recommended architectures for SableBank: (A) VPC Peering — preserves source IP + SNI if termination is on-customer-side; (B) PrivateLink + proxy_protocol — preserves client IP via proxy header but requires proxy, SNI depends on where TLS is terminated.
Sabeel: great. pricing question: does PrivateLink vs Peering affect POC pricing or bandwidth billing? they asked for delta.
Olivia: for us, hosted PrivateLink has egress costs and endpoint hours; Peering involves cross-account data transfer (depends on AWS account setup). Sales should flag potential egress metering on our quote.
Kevin: we should add a line item: `Managed PrivateLink` vs `Peering Support` — peering may be included for Private deployments but could incur network engineering time.
Sabeel: can we give them a one-pager for the security questionnaire answers for network section? something short: allowed ports, IPs, architecture options, and recommended pattern.
Raj: I'll draft the network section — include firewall snippet: ```
Allowed outbound ports (customer->redwood): TCP 443 (HTTPS), TCP 80 (health check opt-in), TCP 123 (NTP optional)
If using proxy_protocol: allow health ports on 10256
Egress IPs: see published list per-region (provide link)
```
Olivia: also add this statement: "For POCs, Redwood can support VPC Peering or AWS PrivateLink. VPC Peering preserves original source IPs; PrivateLink uses ENIs and requires proxy protocol or customer-side proxy to surface client IPs. TLS termination location affects SNI exposure."
Sabeel: perfect. last: can we propose a small network test for the POC: verify source-ip in app logs, verify SNI visibility, and confirm port allowlist? owner?
Kevin: I'll own the test. plan: spin up POC NLB with proxy_protocol_v2 -> customer test app; verify logs; then repeat with Peering. ETA: tomorrow EOD.
Sabeel: I'll update the sales quote to include a line for network engineering time (4 hours) and note the possible egress charges.
Olivia: I'll sign off on the questionnaire wording once Raj drafts it.
Raj: draft done, pushing to the doc repo: https://redwood.internal/docs/poc-network-sablebank (will replace example IPs with region-specific list)
Sabeel: thanks all. @Kevin please ping me when tests pass so I can share with the customer. :thumbsup:
Kevin: will do.
Olivia: small note for SOC review — if customer requires TLS inspection, add a compliance ticket to confirm key management and logging retention.
Sabeel: added to action items. closing thread after test results.
